svg.title: fig03 registry services
svg.desc: Registration, semantics, discovery and use Legal functions and proposed architecture have different evidentiary status STATUTORY EU REGISTRY FUNCTIONS Registration record Identifiers, metadata and registration-event records. A registration proof is not proof that every claim is true. Semantic repository Commission-governed models, definitions, vocabularies, roles and model metadata. Legal provision does not prove model availability or operational validation. PROPOSED FEDERATED SERVICES AND CONSUMER CONTROLS Discovery catalogue Metadata to find data, services and authoritative references. Semantic hub / vocabulary service Versioned domain models and mappings, with provenance. Evidence host / source Product evidence stays with its custodian. Retrieval follows the applicable access policy. Consumer admission controls Check purpose, authority, proof, status and freshness before admitting evidence for a decision. Arrows show proposed information use; no cross-ecosystem implementation was tested.
